title: Touching craft pieces with Garry Nolan

tellings.quote: Like I've seen pieces of a craft. I've been with Garry Nolan. I don't know if they're real pieces of a craft, but like they seem.

plain: Jesse Michels says he has seen pieces said to come from a UFO craft while he was with the scientist Garry Nolan. Michels tells it himself and adds that he doesn't know if they are real pieces of a craft, "but like they seem." If they were real, it would mean physical material from such a craft exists and is being looked at by scientists.
